synapse_panel.title: Synapse
synapse_panel.label_verbatim: Seeded from recorded IBM Quantum outcomes. Recorded, not live. The physics is classical math; the quantum is the seed.
synapse_panel.unavailable: Outcomes not found. Can't seed from this one.
synapse_panel.failed_run_note: No violation in this run. It still counts as a seed.

how_its_drawn: The 3D world renders small, then each pixel is scaled up whole.
Colors snap to a 65-color palette, matched by how bright they look.
Edges darken where depth jumps more than half a meter.
Water mirrors the beach and wobbles on its own waves.
Wind, waves, serves and mistakes all draw from one recorded quantum stream, in order. Replay it and you get the same world.
